answers.why: Israel is called to return to the LORD and remove its abominations.
The LORD addresses the men of Judah alongside Jerusalem.
The men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem are commanded to cleanse their hearts.
Judah is the territory where the warning is proclaimed and people gather into fortified cities.
The house of Israel is threatened with invasion by a distant nation.
The message is published in Judah to the foolish people addressed next.
The remnant of Israel is a surviving population to be gleaned like a vine.
All Judah denotes the worshippers entering the temple gates.
The God of Israel addresses the community and commands them to amend their ways.
Israel is explicitly called God's people whose wickedness brought judgment on Shiloh.
The God of Israel addresses a community whose forefathers he brought out of Egypt.
The God of Israel announces punishment and dispersion of this people.
Judah is listed alongside Egypt and other nations facing punishment.
All the house of Israel is collectively described as uncircumcised in heart.
